correctness.rationale: Exact g-difference factorization gives uniform contraction by >=2/even and >=3/odd and hence a unique parity root. From the first g-image, difference valuation grows exactly by three on every further g-step. For initial even/odd residues, g(x)-r factors as (x-r)(x+r)(x²+r²+2), with last factor valuations one/two, respectively. Thus the counting problem reduces to congruences y²=a² mod 2^h; there are four solutions for h>=3, proving the stated complete cumulative distributions and maxima. The packaged Python checker independently enumerates all 262142 residues across moduli 2^1 through 2^17; enumeration is auxiliary only.

value.rationale: The full finite-level first-arrival census of the standard dyadic quadratic map is a natural quantitative invariant of the attracting functional graph. It refines Fan--Liao qualitative basin classification, distinguishes odd/even transient layers, and resolves the exact logarithmic-depth cutoff for all finite levels. This is a structurally motivated infinite classification, not a table fragment or code-only observation.
